title: Navimower 0.4.6-beta6

## Fresh-install History baseline and bounded restart recovery

This beta changes the first-install behavior for vendor-retained current-cycle trail geometry.

A fresh Navimower installation no longer adopts the vendor's already-retained route prefix for a mowing cycle that started before the integration began tracking that mower. Instead, the first observed vendor endpoint becomes a persistent install baseline. Only geometry that appears after that baseline is retained locally.

### Fresh install

- A new config entry persists a tracking checkpoint immediately when no VendorTrailStore exists.
- Vendor geometry from a cycle that started before that checkpoint is not imported into local History/current-cycle storage.
- The first observed point count and endpoint are stored only as a baseline marker.
- Later growth of the same vendor cycle is retained from that baseline forward.
- If the vendor rewrites the compressed geometry so the old endpoint can no longer be matched, the baseline moves forward instead of importing an unknown historical prefix.
- A genuinely new mowing cycle after installation is retained normally from its beginning.

### Home Assistant restart recovery

The install baseline and latest recovery checkpoint are persisted with VendorTrailStore.

After a restart, the first successful retained-trail poll compares the vendor source point count with the stored checkpoint/source count. Only newly appeared suffix geometry is adopted for a pre-install cycle. Existing locally retained current-cycle geometry remains intact.

This preserves the intended use case: a normal Home Assistant restart can recover the few minutes of route missed while Home Assistant was down without turning a fresh installation into an unbounded historical import.

### Upgrades

Existing installations are not treated as fresh installs. A pre-beta6 VendorTrailStore without recovery metadata is migrated as an existing store and its retained geometry is preserved.

### Diagnostics

Download diagnostics now expose privacy-safe recovery state under History:

- bootstrap mode;
- tracking-start checkpoint;
- number of zones carrying a pre-install baseline;
- number of pre-install source points deliberately skipped;
- baseline re-anchor count;
- latest recovery checkpoint;
- restart recovery pending state;
- recovery count;
- last recovery gap duration;
- last recovered source-point count and zone count.

No route coordinates or raw vendor trail payloads are added to diagnostics.

### Compatibility

- No change to mower commands, Schedule, Resume, Gate or zone-progress semantics.
- No change to Prepared History rendering format.
- Existing retained History/session stores remain intact.
- The change applies only to first adoption of vendor-retained geometry on a genuinely fresh installation and to the persisted recovery metadata used afterwards.
